title: 彭博经济学家曲天石：央行需引导预期，银行才会降低长期利率
speaker: David Qu

segments.en: But then suddenly we have to go back to the old playbook. And the benchmark rates, which tend to move some of the market rates even further, correct me from wrong.
segments.zh: 但突然要回到旧剧本，基准利率往往能带动部分市场利率进一步下行，我说得对吗？

segments.en: That is the problem. If you return to 20 years ago, things could be easier. But now it is a market oriented system, right?
segments.zh: 问题就在这里。如果回到20年前，事情会更容易。但现在是市场化体系，对吧？

segments.en: And the banks need to have certain interest rate margin so that they keep their profit. So what the PBOC can do, right?
segments.zh: 银行需要一定的利差来维持利润。那么央行能做什么呢？

segments.en: You need to make the market believe you are going to do more using ahead. And so that the bank will lower their long rates. That is the channel.
segments.zh: 你需要让市场相信你会提前采取更多行动，这样银行才会降低长期利率。这就是传导渠道。
